title: Cosmic Sea Turtle
description: A vibrant green sea turtle with yellow patterned shell swims across a swirling cosmic background. The scene features flowing, wave-like ribbons of purple, blue, orange and yellow against a starry night sky with nebulae.
prompt: A detailed green sea turtle with yellow segmented shell and flippers swimming gracefully through a surreal cosmic ocean. Swirling ribbons of purple, teal, orange and yellow fabric-like waves flow around the turtle against a deep space background filled with stars and colorful nebulae, vibrant fantasy illustration style
